subject.title: fix(auth): count token-type profiles in provider health status rollup

question: Should the gateway model-auth status contract treat an effective token/setup-token profile as healthy provider auth when no effective OAuth profile exists, even for OAuth-capable or OAuth-configured providers?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive operator alerting and auth-status decision; the code path is correct for the reported setup-token migration, but the final contract belongs to maintainers because existing mixed auth setups may see different missing/healthy status after upgrade.

options.title: Accept Token Fallback Rollup
options.body: Land this PR's gateway projection rule so effective token/setup-token profiles clear the false missing status when OAuth is absent, while preserving explicit auth-order exclusions.

options.title: Require OAuth-Only Status
options.body: Keep OAuth-configured providers missing unless an effective OAuth profile exists, accepting that setup-token migrations need a separate config or migration path.

options.title: Move The Contract Elsewhere
options.body: Pause this PR and define the token-vs-OAuth health contract in shared auth-health or runtime auth selection before changing the gateway projection.

recommendation.title: Accept Token Fallback Rollup
recommendation.body: Land this PR's gateway projection rule so effective token/setup-token profiles clear the false missing status when OAuth is absent, while preserving explicit auth-order exclusions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on the PR and has the strongest recent path history for auth-health/status rollup behavior.
